The IDs of the templates that you want to delete.

title.zh: 删除自定义云电脑模板

descriptions.zh: 模板删除之后， 已基于该模板创建的云电脑不受影响，与该模板关联的资源不受影响。
descriptions.en: Deleting a template does not affect cloud computers created from it or the associated resources.
